stem:
Gauri looks at a number line from 3000 to 4000. The interval is divided into five equal parts with marks at equal spacing.

What number does the first mark after 3000 show?

options.text: 3001, treating each mark as one unit.
3500, splitting the interval into two equal halves only.
4000, jumping straight to the right endpoint.

teacher.key_rationale: A 1000-unit interval cut into five equal parts gives steps of 200. The first mark after 3000 is 3200.
